
# Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/), and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

Order of the subsections should be consistent: `Added` > `Changed` > `Deprecated` > `Removed` > `Fixed` > `Security`.

Change lines be like:

`- <description_of_the_change> \ PR: <id1>[, <id2>, <id3>...]; Trello: <id1>[, <id2>, <id3>...]; Jira: <id1>[, <id2>, <id3>...];`

**Note:** This file is automatically generated via `$ VERSION=X.Y.Z make release`. Please see the [developer
documentation](https://www.notion.so/fksl/Trabajo-en-el-repositorio-0dcf2eb50cfa499fa15ecf59ae60b976#215eda9892a445a2b51dd781ada76aa5) for instructions on adding your own entry.
